releases.notes: Simplifies Windows site database creation, starts the database server, updates .env, clears Laravel configuration, and opens TablePlus in one action. Fixes MariaDB administrator permissions, restores the prominent php artisan dev control, removes separate queue and scheduler controls, and displays application update results without waiting for component checks.

Fixes Windows PHP setup failures caused by temporary access-denied file locks. Failed installations restore the previous runtime, preserve backups when recovery is blocked, and retain the original installation error. Also updates the site development-process controls and removes obsolete localization resources.

Adds one-click Laravel site controls on Windows that start the local environment, enabled managed services, mail capture, queue worker, and scheduler together, with a matching stop action for the selected site's queue and scheduler.

Keeps Windows PHP FastCGI workers available for the lifetime of the local environment so PHP sites remain responsive after sustained use instead of stopping when the previous per-worker request limit is reached.

Adds a complete site workspace with health checks, Git and runtime details, favorite commands, managed development servers, per-site database provisioning, guided repair workflows, and improved local HTTP and FastCGI connection stability.

Adds dashboard-wide automatic repair, resilient update checks, automatic Xdebug installation, a tray Exit command, and managed Vite, Next.js, and FastAPI development servers behind local HTTPS. Empty non-project folders are excluded and repaired sites restart immediately without returning stale HTTPS 404 responses.

Adds one-click local Laravel project reset with project and database backup, automatic database recovery after failure, cache and log cleanup, and a compact scrollable operation log that preserves command output line breaks.

Adds one-click Laravel updates with automatic backup and rollback, project cleanup and rebuild, transferable project exports with optional database dumps, local mail setup, and pre-handoff audit reports.

Adds determinate SQL import progress with size and time remaining, merges only missing rows into existing MySQL and MariaDB tables, automatically repairs common SQL compatibility problems, and shows the real database error instead of a closed-pipe message.

Adds per-version PHP extension management and important PHP settings, background update checks, resilient database import with automatic creation, a compact interface, a vertical site action rail, and health dashboard repair actions.

Adds service port conflict inspection with owning process and PID detection, one-click port repair, and per-site favorite commands for Artisan, Composer, and npm. Also includes advanced queue management, read-only database inspection, SQL import, scheduler management, performance monitoring, Laravel repair, and Redis and SQLite support across managed PHP versions.

Enables PHP intl and exif automatically for Filament and Spatie packages, repairs existing managed PHP runtimes before Composer starts, and routes moved Laravel projects to public/index.php instead of stale index.html placeholders.

Checks PHP, Node.js/npm, Composer, Laravel Installer, Git, Xdebug, MySQL, and every installed managed service for updates in the background, then shows one notification for all available component updates.

Checks for HerdMe updates automatically at startup, clearly notifies you when a newer version is available, and no longer reports that HerdMe is up to date when the online update service could not be reached.

Prevents empty mail and replaced site previews from reporting WebView failures, pins compatible Windows SDK references for reproducible self-contained builds, and fixes the PowerShell 5.1 formatting gate.

Fixes persistent service installation and service-list refresh, writes mail settings directly to each site's .env file, ships a self-contained Windows installer, repairs npm and npx for PowerShell, and improves Artisan and npm command dialogs with suggestions and visible run controls.
